messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — bringing up peacock-embed-v2 (llama2-embed-derived) on int8 per-channel. baseline fp16 looked good, but on the wiki_holdout we see an odd short-query recall hit. posting quick numbers.

Maria: can you paste the eval snapshot? :eyes:

Samir: quick paste from the holdout run:
```
model: peacock-embed-v2 int8-per-channel
dataset: wiki_holdout_10k
overall:
  recall@1: 0.62   (fp16 baseline: 0.71)
  recall@5: 0.84   (baseline: 0.87)
  mrr:      0.68   (baseline: 0.74)
short_queries (<6 tokens):
  recall@1: 0.45   (baseline: 0.69)
note: embedding norm mean shifted +0.18 vs fp16
```

Eva: whoa — that's a massive hit for short queries. Did the preprocessing or normalization flag change between runs?

Alex: I double-checked the preprocessing, same tokenization. But the runtime default changed — previously we normalized embeddings after pooling. the int8 serving path left normalize=False to avoid a kernel branch. so we effectively compared normalized fp16 to unnormalized int8. my bad.

Samir: that explains it. cosine sim is sensitive to norm. re-running with explicit post-normalize on the int8 vectors now.

Maria: while you re-run, can we also try per-tensor int8 vs per-channel? Maybe quant bias on short sequences.

Samir: will run both. quick command I used:
```
# eval harness
python eval/embeddings_eval.py \\
  --model peacock-embed-v2 --quant int8_pc --normalize True \\
  --dataset wiki_holdout_10k --split short_queries
```

embed-ci-bot: Test run queued: embed-holdout/peacock-int8-2026-03-14-2 (job id: 8421) :gear:

Alex: initial re-run (normalize=True) results — short queries up to 0.67 recall@1, overall recall@1 0.70. so normalization recovered most of the gap.

Eva: good — so it's a runtime flag mismatch, not a representational collapse. still want the per-tensor vs per-channel numbers.

Samir: per-tensor int8 (no norm) -> short recall@1: 0.52; per-channel int8 (no norm) -> 0.60. with explicit normalize both end up ~0.66-0.68. so per-channel better but normalization is the bigger factor.

Maria: action items:
- Alex: update serving config to always apply post-quantize normalize for cosine routes (unless using dot product) — low risk.
- Samir: run a small sweep: int8_pc vs int8_pt vs int4 (per-channel) on wiki_holdout and short-query slice, push numbers to the eval dashboard.
- Eva: add a short-query check to the onboarding checklist for new embed models (recall@1 delta for <6 tokens).

Alex: noted. I’ll open a PR to change default for cosine endpoints and add a small test in the runtime. tagging @Maria for review.

Maria: LGTM, thanks for catching the flag mismatch. :thumbsup:

Samir: I'll upload the full logs and the small vector-norm histos to the thread later.

Eva: nice triage. once Samir posts the sweep, we can decide if we need calibration (scale/bias) in the quant pipeline for very short contexts.

Alex: thanks all — saved a potential regression for customers using short snippets. closing loop once the PR and sweep land. :)
